sentence_stem: If I had more free time,
correct_completion: I would learn to play the guitar.
full_sentence: If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
acceptable_variants: I would take up a new hobby.
I would start reading more books.

options.text: I learned to play the guitar last year.
options.why_wrong: This uses the past simple for a completed action in the past. The second conditional needs 'would' plus the base verb to describe an unreal present situation.

options.text: I will learn to play the guitar next week.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' expresses a real future plan. The sentence needs the hypothetical form 'would' because the condition 'had more free time' is unlikely.

options.text: I would learn to play the guitar.
I am learning to play the guitar right now.
options.why_wrong: This describes a present action in progress. It does not form a result clause after an 'if' clause that describes an imagined situation.

grammar_focus: Second conditional: if + past simple, would + base verb
explanation: The second conditional describes an unreal or unlikely present situation. The if-clause uses the past simple, and the main clause uses would plus the base verb. Learners often transfer the future form from their first language here, which produces will instead of would.
translation: Se eu tivesse mais tempo livre, aprenderia a tocar violão.
